title: The school directory (public/archive/schools.json and states/<ST>/schools.json)
description: /api/v1/schools (every state, no `state`) and /api/v1/states/{ST}/schools (one state, with `state`). hsdash.py validate also checks that `count` is the number of rows, the state directories add up to the full one, and every row matches its school file. `_meta.asOf` is null: it is built from several brackets.
